extracted.name: Banana and Peanut Butter 4-Ingredient ‘Ice Cream’
extracted.description: This banana and peanut butter 4-ingredient ‘ice cream’ recipe is easy to make using bananas, confectioners’ sugar, milk vanilla extract, and peanut butter.
ingredient_lines: 2 slightly overripe bananas, cut into chunks
1 teaspoon peanut butter, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Place banana chunks on a plate; freeze until solid, about 2 hours.
Place frozen bananas, confectioners’ sugar, milk, and vanilla extract in a blender; blend until smooth and creamy. Add peanut butter; blend until smooth.
